question: If {{(4x + 2y)³} + {(4x-2y)³}}=16({Ax³ + Bxy²}), then what is the value of {1over 2 }{(sqrt{A² +B²})}?
solution:
**Given:**

(4x + 2y)³ + (4x - 2y)³ = 16 (Ax³ + Bxy²) .....(1)

**Formula used:**

a³ + b³ = (a + b) (a² + b² - ab)

(a + b)2 + (a - b)2 = 2 (a2 + b2)

a2 - b2 = (a + b) (a - b)

**Calculation:**

(4x + 2y)3 + (4x - 2y)3 = (4x + 2y + 4x - 2y) [(4x + 2y)2 + (4x - 2y)2 - (4x + 2y) (4x - 2y)]

(4x + 2y)3 + (4x - 2y)3 = 8x [2 (16x² + 4y²)] - (16x² - 4y²)

(4x + 2y)3 + (4x - 2y)3 = 8x (32x² + 8y² - 16x2 + 4y2)

(4x + 2y)3 + (4x - 2y)3 = 8x (16x2 + 12y2)

(4x + 2y)3 + (4x - 2y)3 = 16 (8x3 + 6xy2) .....(2)

Justifying equations (1) and (2),

A = 8 and B = 6

So, (1/2) √(A² + B²) = (1/2) √(82 + 62)

= 1/2 × √(64 + 36)

= 1/2 × √100

= 1/2 × 10 = 5

**∴ The value of (1/2) √(A2 + B2) is 5**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

(4x + 2y)3 + (4x - 2y)3 = 16 (Ax3 + Bxy2) –––––––– (1)

(a +b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b) 

(4x + 2y)³ = 64x³ + 8y³ + 24xy(4x + 2y)

⇒ 64x3 + 8y3 + 96x²y + 48xy² –––––––– (2)

And, (4x – 2y)3 = 64x3 – 8y3 – 24xy(4x – 2y)

⇒ 64x3 – 8y3 – 96x2y + 48xy² –––––––– (3)

Adding the equation 1 and 2, we have

 (4x + 2y)3 + (4x - 2y)³ = 128x³ + 96xy² = 16(8x³ + 6xy²) –– (4)

Justifying equations (1) and (4), we have

A = 8, and B = 6

{1over 2 }{(√{A² +B²})} = 1over2 sqrt{A²+B²} = 1over2 sqrt{8²+6²} 

⇒ 1over2 × 10 = 5

∴ **The value of 1over2sqrt{A²+B²} is 5**
